title: Cipher and Contact
author: Jonah Winterbourne
blurb: Bram Thackeray, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
